position: The contracts are implementation-ready; every real connection and activation decision is still visible as missing
headline: Four implementation contracts are proven. Real infrastructure and activation remain separate decisions.
copy: The control room prevents a mature prototype from being mistaken for a live service. It shows the exact evidence still needed before private implementation, then requires another founder decision before any invitation.

postures.title: Authorization evaluator
postures.copy: The private implementation decision is deterministic and bounded.

postures.title: Manifest and identity
postures.copy: Configuration and claim contracts reject unsafe inputs.

postures.title: Queue migration
postures.copy: The event ledger detects tampering and replays state.

postures.title: Real infrastructure
postures.copy: Provider, secrets, IdP, database, and audits are unconnected.

flow.title: Review
flow.copy: Read the authorization, manifest, identity, and queue evidence.

flow.title: Connect
flow.copy: Implement the smallest approved stack in a private environment.

flow.title: Repeat
flow.copy: Run security, privacy, rights, recovery, and failure-mode reviews.

flow.title: Decide
flow.copy: Require a separate founder activation record before one invitation.

decisions.label: Implementation contracts
decisions.reason: The complete authorization chain is executable and linked.

decisions.label: Real connections
decisions.reason: Provider, secrets, identity, and database are absent.

locks.title: Deployment lock
locks.copy: No provider endpoint, domain, runtime, or credential is active.

locks.title: Identity lock
locks.copy: The claim contract does not authenticate a real reviewer.

locks.title: Storage lock
locks.copy: Ledger semantics are verified without a connected durable provider.

locks.title: Invitation lock
locks.copy: No invitation token, participant, or external session exists.

locks.title: Public launch lock
locks.copy: Implementation readiness cannot activate a public service.
